Thirteen methods call `trace::async_op` directly. All of them are in the `tokio` crate, and every call looks like `trace::async_op(`. I found them with the code index and then checked with a separate grep, which turned up the same 13 call sites and no others.

- **`Barrier`** (`tokio/src/sync/barrier.rs`): `wait`
- **`Mutex`** (`tokio/src/sync/mutex.rs`): `lock`, `lock_owned`
- **`oneshot::Sender`** (`tokio/src/sync/oneshot.rs`): `closed`
- **`RwLock`** (`tokio/src/sync/rwlock.rs`): `read`, `read_owned`, `write`, `write_owned`
- **`Semaphore`** (`tokio/src/sync/semaphore.rs`): `acquire`, `acquire_many`, `acquire_owned`, `acquire_many_owned`
- **`Interval`** (`tokio/src/time/interval.rs`): `tick`
